activities.description: Male Anchor introduces the topic of Congressional changes and asks the Female Guest for her perspective.
Female Guest talks about the state of the American economy, expressing concern that it's stuck in the 20th century and needs a jumpstart through innovation and deregulation.
Male Anchor asks clarifying questions about the Female Guest’s stance on undoing Obama-era regulations, specifically those related to the EPA and Obamacare.

characterInteraction.description: Interaction between Male Anchor and Female Guest where the anchor asks questions, and the guest responds elaborating on her views.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The discussion of economic policies and the need for innovation amid regulatory challenges in America.

narrativeProgression.description: Female Guest states the central problem of the American economy.
She proposes her solution of moving to a 21st-century economy.
Male Anchor confirms her stance on deregulation.

youtube_description:
Dr Annette Teijeiro announced her candidacy for Nevada Congressional District 3 on the Alan Stock radio show. She is  bidding for the seat being vacated by Dr Joe Heck. She is a republican, fiscal conservative and strong advocate for the US Constitution.  She is against Obamacare and would appeal it as well as Planned Parenthood.

Our Country needs to get back on track with more respect among people, a health insurance program that won't bankrupt you and allowing you to keep all of your paycheck through tax reform.

I am an highly experienced medical doctor who understands the laws that affect our health and security. I am a Latina who's father fled Cuba under an oppressive Castro regime and understand the glory of freedom and working hard.

I want to earn your vote in the 2016 election and be a true voice Of the People, by the People.

We need to boost this video and ones similar to this. For a donation of $10, we can promote to about 5,000 people in her district. Please pledge what you can to http://friendsforannette.com/donate.htm. 

Dr. Annette Teijeiro is running against Andy Matthews of NPRI, Nevada State Senator Michael Roberson (aka Tax Hike Mike and who helped create the largest tax increase in Nevada history), and Danny Tarkanian. Danny Tarkanian is the son of Jerry Tarkanian and has lost in several other political races.

For more information on Dr. Annette and to donate to the campaign please visit,
http://www.AnnetteforCongress.com
